Name: A Slightly Cuter Version of Marlon for Seasonal Slightly Cuter Marlon ( Vanilla Friendly )
Author: jasmgne
Description:
I am but a simple person. I see an NPC and think, "Hmm, what if they were a little hotter?"
That's how this mod came to be. I'm not an artist, and don't claim to be one, but I thought I'd share the Marlon portraits I made for my game.
You need [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ or alternatively [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url], depending on what version of Marlon you are going to download. This mod will do nothing if it is not downloaded!

HOW TO INSTALL:

Pay mind to what file you are downloading because the normal version and SVE version won't work interchangeably.

FOR Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic

[list]
[*]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. Download the mod manually and unzip.
[*]Open the folder [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters, open assets folder, then the Portrait folder
[*]Copy and paste the Marlon folder into the Portraits folder
[*]Replace files when prompted
[/list]
FOR Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE

[list]
[*]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. Download the mod manually and unzip.
[*]Open the folder [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE, open the assets folder, then the Portrait folder
[*]Copy and paste the MarlonFay folder into the Portraits folder
[*]Replace files when prompted
[/list]
